paired_comparison.note: Eight development groups; intervals are exploratory, and degenerate intervals do not establish equivalence.

notes: Exploratory development pilot; no validation/test evaluation or globally optimal round is selected.
Round 3 is the prespecified primary communication-minus-self-revision comparison; all other rounds are descriptive.
Both branch trajectories include exactly the same initial evidence and historical call cost; execution cost counts it once.
Reported call seconds are sums of measured model-request durations, excluding human pauses and intervening calls of the other branch; they are not end-to-end study wall time.
Branches match generation counts, not input-token or time budgets. Missing token measurements remain unknown.
Division by zero is an undefined model expression, not evidence of incorrect calculator arithmetic.
Eligible wrong expressions measure delivered mathematical errors; explanations and hidden reasoning are not graded.
This is a post-failure protocol amendment, not a completed run under the original v1 stopping policy.
The original failed v1 evidence is preserved. Its 146 raw generations are reused; 145 previous evaluations are unchanged and the truncated response is evaluated locally without another model call.
new_calls and new_generation_cost describe only the 334 requests generated by this continuation; total_revision_calls and all_revision_generation_cost include all 480 revision outcomes.

Both trajectories include the same 80 historical initial calls and their respective historical imported revisions. Physical unique cost counts each of the 560 initial/revision generations once across runs.

A length-truncated invalid JSON response contributes one ineligible outcome, including its original token and request-duration costs. Its unmodified raw text is not repaired or forwarded as a complete explanation.
The observed failure motivated this amendment; findings remain exploratory, with the same round-3 comparison and no new round selection or hidden-reasoning grading.

protocol_amendment.policy: Only invalid JSON returned at the unchanged 1024-token length stop becomes one ineligible response; other schema violations remain fatal.
